description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It handles the import of test execution results from XML files, including processing uploaded files, parsing XML data, validating and saving test results and associated information such as bugs, custom fields, and steps. The script defines multiple core functions for importing, validating, and processing test results, as well as initializing the import interface and handling user inputs.

methods.name: importExecutionResultsFromXML
methods.description: Imports test execution results from an XML file after loading and validating the XML structure.

methods.name: importResults
methods.description: Parses the XML data to extract test execution results, update execution context, and invoke save operation.

methods.name: saveImportedResultData
methods.description: Saves the imported test results into the database, including execution info, steps, bugs, custom fields, and related validations.

methods.name: importExecutionsFromXML
methods.description: Processes a set of individual execution XML elements into internal data structures.

methods.name: importExecutionFromXML
methods.description: Converts a single test execution XML element into an internal associative array with all relevant data.

methods.name: check_xml_execution_results
methods.description: Validates whether the uploaded XML file appears to be a valid test results XML structure.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments and user input parameters from the $_REQUEST superglobal, handling file uploads and IDs.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI configuration object for the import page, including titles, IDs, and validation info.
